idea-plugin.name: VulnSpeed - GPU-Accelerated SAST
idea-plugin.description:
VulnSpeed — GPU-Accelerated SAST for Real-Time Vulnerability Detection

Security scanning at the speed of thought. VulnSpeed detects OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25 vulnerabilities as you type across 7 languages, with one-click auto-fixes and optional GPU acceleration for instant results on large codebases.

Real-Time Detection

  • As-You-Type Scanning — Vulnerabilities highlighted inline in the editor with severity levels
  • OWASP Top 10 Coverage — Injection, broken access control, cryptographic failures, SSRF, and more
  • CWE Top 25 Coverage — SQL injection, XSS, OS command injection, and 22+ more
  • 7 Languages — Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C/C++, and Swift

Secrets Detection

  • 12 High-Signal Secret Rules — AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Stripe, Google, SendGrid, Twilio, npm tokens, private key blocks, JWTs, and credentials embedded in URLs
  • Near-Zero False Positives — Vendor-specific token formats, not noisy entropy heuristics

Remediation & Workflow

  • One-Click Auto-Fix — Alt+Enter to apply automated remediation suggestions instantly
  • Inline Suppression — // vulnspeed-ignore or // vulnspeed-ignore: RULE_ID comments to accept findings where you decide they are fine
  • File Scanning — Right-click in editor to scan the current file on demand
  • Project Scanning — Right-click a folder to scan the entire project with severity breakdown
  • Security Dashboard — Tool window with vulnerability list, statistics, and quick access to fixes
  • Shareable Reports — Export findings as SARIF 2.1.0, CycloneDX SBOM, or a self-contained HTML report

Advanced Analysis

  • GPU Acceleration — Metal/CUDA/Vulkan accelerated engine, 50-100x faster than CPU scanning
  • Taint Analysis — Advanced data flow tracking across function boundaries
  • AI False Positive Filtering — ML-based filtering to reduce noise
  • Custom Security Rules — Define organization-specific vulnerability patterns
  • Compliance Reports — Generate SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS reports
  • CI/CD Integration — Run VulnSpeed in your pipeline for gated security checks

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)
  • JDK 17+
  • 2 GB free RAM
  • GPU optional (Metal, CUDA, or Vulkan for Pro acceleration)

Support

  • Issue Tracker
  • Documentation
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.6.7 — Internal API fix (Marketplace review)

  • Plugin-version lookup now uses the public PluginManager.getPluginByClass() API at all 6 call sites — no more plugin-by-ID lookup (getPlugin / findEnabledPlugin), which the Marketplace review flagged as internal and warned may start returning null

2026.6.1 — Platform API cleanup

  • Plugin-version lookup migrated to the public PluginManager API; removed internal-API imports from the editor annotator

2026.6.0 — Secrets, Suppression & Reports

  • Secrets Detection — 12 new high-signal rules for AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Stripe, Google, SendGrid, Twilio, npm tokens, private key blocks, JWTs, and credentials in URLs (CWE-798)
  • Inline Suppression — // vulnspeed-ignore and // vulnspeed-ignore: RULE_ID comments suppress findings on a line; vulnspeed-ignore-file opts out a whole file
  • HTML Report Export — Self-contained HTML security report with severity summary cards and per-finding detail, ready to share
  • Kotlin inline highlighting — As-you-type annotations now also run in Kotlin files (was advertised but never registered)
  • Fixed: Findings in the first 10 columns of a line crashed snippet extraction and were silently dropped
  • Fixed: Editor annotations were created asynchronously after the highlighting pass ended, so inline highlights never appeared reliably
  • New tool window icon and dark-theme plugin icon

2026.4.1 — Archive Fix

  • Fixed archive extraction — Rebuilt plugin distribution to fix "archive cannot be extracted" error on JetBrains Marketplace

What's New

  • Real-Time Vulnerability Detection - Finds OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25 vulnerabilities as you type with inline severity highlighting
  • Multi-Language Support - Full scanning for Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C/C++, and Swift
  • One-Click Auto-Fix - Automated remediation suggestions applied instantly via Alt+Enter
  • File and Project Scanning - On-demand scanning of individual files or entire projects with results in the VulnSpeed tool window
  • Security Dashboard - Bottom panel displaying vulnerability list, statistics, severity breakdown, and quick access to fixes
  • GPU-Accelerated Scanning - Metal, CUDA, and Vulkan accelerated engine for 50-100x faster analysis on large codebases
  • Advanced Taint Analysis - Data flow and taint tracking to trace vulnerability propagation paths
  • AI False Positive Filtering - Machine learning based filtering to reduce noise and surface real vulnerabilities
  • Compliance Reports - Generate SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS compliance reports from scan results
  • Custom Security Rules - Define organization-specific vulnerability patterns and detection rules
